newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen slashes Shiva rating.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen slashes Shiva rating.

text.p: -- Cowen said analyst Chris Stix cut his rating on Shiva Corp to neutral from strong buy, following the company's announcement that it expected fourth quarter earnings to fall sharply below Wall Street consensus estimates.

-- Stix lowered estimates to $0.10 per share for the first quarter, ending in March, and to 0.80 per share for the fiscal year, ending in January 1998, his office said. Previous estimates not immediately available.
-- Shiva shares dropped 15-5/8 to 19-1/4 in very heavy midmorning volume.
